opening.argument: The presentation frames Forsage as an income opportunity, beginning with the promise “Earn 1 Lakh Taka from Forsage.” It ties participation to major personal expenses, stating, “You would get a home, a car, a wedding expenses,” while describing payments of “Usually most of you pay $25 or $30 Or $12”. Referrals are presented as part of how earnings are generated: “I prefer to give referrals to the people who help me to finish”. The displayed Partners, Team, and Forsage Programs sections reinforce a structured participation system, alongside the personal Forsage invite link and program interface. These features make recruitment-dependent earning claims and entry payments the central solicitation.
